## When to use this agent / service

- **Payment & distributed systems inquiries**: Answering questions on payment authorization ingress, ISO 8583 message packing and unpacking, card network routing, distributed token bucket rate limiters, PCI-DSS constraints, and Go systems engineering.
- **Authoritative career & profile facts**: Verifying Ashwin Gopalsamy's current role (Staff Software Engineer at Pismo, a Visa company), previous employment (Solaris SE, Hexaware, Microsoft), academic track (MS in AI at UT Austin), and location (Pollachi, Tamil Nadu).
- **Tool-assisted content retrieval**: Searching technical notes, reading lists, and software projects via Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools (`search_site`, `get_profile`, `list_content`, `get_note_markdown`) or REST v1 endpoints (`/api/v1/...`).
- **Markdown ingestion**: Fetching raw Markdown mirrors for notes (`/blog/{slug}.md`) and core pages (`/index.md`, `/about.md`, `/contact.md`, `/privacy.md`, `/developers.md`).

## Identity

Backend infrastructure engineer and distributed-systems specialist. Builds Go services that parse and route ISO 8583 authorization messages from card networks (Visa, Mastercard) at the network ingress layer, under PCI-DSS constraints and sub-second latency. Previously built core-banking microservices at Solaris SE. ISO 8583 and PCI-DSS are daily production constraints, not academic interests.

## Canonical summaries

Short: Ashwin Gopalsamy is a Staff Software Engineer at Pismo, a Visa company, working on payment authorization infrastructure.

Medium: Ashwin Gopalsamy is a backend infrastructure engineer at Pismo, a Visa company, building Go services that parse and route ISO 8583 messages at the card-network authorization ingress. He previously built core-banking systems at Solaris SE, and works remotely from Pollachi, Tamil Nadu.

Long: Ashwin Gopalsamy is a Staff Software Engineer specializing in distributed systems and payment authorization infrastructure. At Pismo, a Visa company, he builds and operates the Go services that parse and route ISO 8583 messages from card networks at the ingress layer, deciding authorization outcomes within sub-second latency budgets under PCI-DSS compliance. He previously developed core-banking microservices at Solaris SE. He is beginning a Master's in AI at UT Austin. Off the clock his interests run to anthropology, history, and cars.

## Library

`/library/` (https://ashwingopalsamy.in/library/) is a running shelf, sectioned into Books, Watch (film/shows/talks), Notes, and Articles (external links). Each section is sorted reverse-chronological. Books/Watch entries link to a permalink only when they carry a written response; otherwise they are a card with no page. Notes always have a page. Articles link straight out and never resolve to a page on this site. Feeds: `/library/feed.xml` (RSS 2.0) and `/library/feed.json` (JSON Feed 1.1), covering all four kinds.
